title: H-1B Employer Change Planner
description: Plan an H-1B employer transfer: model portability timing under AC21, gap-period work authorization risk, cap-gap, and the financial cost of a job change mid-H1B term.
data_vintage: 2026 — AC21 portability rules (INA §214(n)); USCIS processing time buckets; no FY lottery data (changes annually)
regulatory_citations: INA §214(n) — AC21 H-1B portability: can change employers after I-140 approved + 180 days
USCIS Premium Processing: 15 business days ($2,805 as of FY2025; verify for 2026)
INA §214(n)(2) — 60-day grace period after H-1B termination to change status or depart
